description: Native YouTube captions with remembered language and an alphabetical Auto-translate menu. YouTube 21.41.525 and 21.20.405.

patches.name: Universal Captions - unlock translation languages (experimental)
patches.description: Adds YouTube-native auto-translation targets to Android captions menu. No AI or external translation API.

release_notes:
YouTube-native captions in your preferred language, with remembered language selection and an alphabetical Auto-translate menu.

- YouTube **21.41.525** and **21.20.405** compatibility.
- A curated translation-language catalogue, including Greek, with native entries retained.
- Language choices ordered by their displayed names using the app locale.
- Manual/ASR caption preference and YouTube-native translation when a suitable source is available.
- Remembered language and explicit Off preferences.

**Install:** add this repository as a source in Morphe Manager, or import `universal-captions-1.4.0.mpp`. Replace development-source copies with the release source before patching a clean supported APK.

Validated with automated regression tests, standalone APK patching/rebuilding, and user testing on Waydroid / Android 13. Translation availability varies by video and account; other YouTube versions are unverified. No modified YouTube APK is distributed.
